name: Brutal Grip
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Heavy Duelist.

You can wield a Melee weapon with 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed in one hand.

Versatile Dual Wielder.

While wielding a Melee weapon with V|XPHB|Versatile in one hand, the weapon has the L|XPHB|Light property for you.

name: Field Commander
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Command.

As an action, you can issue a command to an ally within 60 feet that can hear you. It can immediately take an action as a Reaction|XPHB. That action can be used to take only the Attack (one attack only), Dash, Dodge, Hide, Influence, Search, Study, or Utilize action.

Tight Formation.

While you are within 5 feet of two or more allies that don't have the Incapacitated condition, enemies can't have Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls against you.

name: Focused Critical
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Improved Critical.

Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit|XPHB on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

name: Iron Hero
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Underdog's Resolve.

When you are attacked by a creature that has a CR higher than your level, you gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class|XPHB for that attack.

Vengeful Strike.

You have Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls against any creature that has reduced one of your allies to 0 Hit Points|XPHB since the end of your last turn.

Heroic Intervention.

When an enemy you can see takes a Legendary Action, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to intercede, preventing the Legendary Action from happening. You can take this Reaction|XPHB a number of times equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.
